sentences.ar: ركبوا القطار من سان فرانسيسكو باتجاه نيويورك.
sentences.en: They boarded the train from San Francisco toward New York.

sentences.ar: الطريق كان يعبر جبال وسهول كتيرة.
sentences.en: The route crossed many mountains and plains.

sentences.ar: بنص الطريق، وقف القطار قدام جسر خربان.
sentences.en: Midway, the train stopped in front of a broken bridge.

sentences.ar: الناس خافوا، بس قرروا يعبروا بسرعة كبيرة.
sentences.en: The people were scared, but they decided to cross at high speed.
They crossed the bridge safely, and everyone was relieved.

sentences.ar: بس بعدها، هجم ناس على القطار وصار في مشكلة.
sentences.en: But after that, some people attacked the train and there was trouble.

sentences.ar: بالهجوم، انخطف باسبارتو مع كم واحد تانيين.
sentences.en: In the attack, Passepartout was taken along with a few others.

sentences.ar: فوغ ما تركه، وراح يدوّر عليه مع جنود.
sentences.en: Fogg didn't abandon him, and went to look for him with soldiers.

sentences.ar: لقاه وأنقذه، بس هالإشي أخرهم كمان.
sentences.en: He found and rescued him, but this delayed them again.

sentences.ar: ضاع منهم القطار، ولازم يلاقوا طريقة تانية.
sentences.en: They missed the train, and had to find another way.
